Title: Generally available: Ledger in Azure SQL Database

Body.Content:
Ledger in Azure SQL Database allows you to enable cryptographic proof that a database has not been tampered with. Ledger in Azure SQL Database provides a solution for your centralized systems where strengthening trust between parties is required. You can enable ledger functionality on tables in your database and interact with them the same ways you would for any other tables. If even a single bit is altered in the database, the database verification process will detect and report the tampering.

Learn more.
